scope: Visual inspection of explicitly listed original PNG frames; not exhaustive temporal acceptance

products.observations: Native1080p improved angle preserves the readable socket, raised tongue and white tab. Frame242 shows the withdrawn housing with a clear socket gap and lowered yellow tip. The actuator occupies much of the left side without covering the housing in these frames.
products.decision: Improved native1080p macro used for the matching-resolution edit; full temporal acceptance remains separate.

products.observations: Raised tongue/yellow tip and retention tab are distinguishable around the large blue foreground actuator. The withdrawn housing has a visible socket gap at frame242; seated composition remains readable at816. These samples do not by themselves show the complete latch-press transition.
products.decision: Improved macro candidate included with explicit remaining temporal-review limits.

products.observations: Specialized tool, datum pads, cable and withdrawn/reseated housing are visible below the bridge. Bright foreground hardware at the left edge does not cover the connector region in these two frames; macro is still needed for the latch.
products.decision: Improved rear candidate included with explicit remaining temporal-review limits.
